annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/815 of 6 March 2024 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for medical gloves for single use, biological evaluation of medical devices, sterilization of health care products, packaging for terminally sterilized medical devices and processing of health care products
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/815 of 6 March 2024 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for medical gloves for single use, biological evaluation of medical devices, sterilization of health care products, packaging for terminally sterilized medical devices and processing of health care products
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision adding references of eight harmonised standards and amendments (medical gloves, biological evaluation, sterilization, packaging, processing) to the list supporting the Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745, conferring presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Annex to Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 by adding entries 18-25.
Adds EN 455-3:2023, EN ISO 10993-15/-17:2023, EN ISO 17664-2:2023 and amendments to other EN ISO standards.
Compliance confers presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/745.
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal.
